title: honckenya peploides subsp. major
intro: Honckenya peploides subsp. major, commonly known as the sea sandwort, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the family Caryophyllaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for wound healing, skin conditions, and immune system support. The therapeutic actions of Honckenya peploides subsp. major include its ability to exhibit analgesic, anti-arthritic, and anti-cancer properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of Honckenya peploides subsp. major have been shown to possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities, which contribute to its potential therapeutic applications.
